summary: This note is a short biographical entry on Cazzie Russell, an American former professional basketball player and coach. It states his birth date, notes that he was an NBA All-Star, and records that the New York Knicks drafted him first overall in 1966. It also mentions that he won an NBA championship with the Knicks in 1970.
one_line: Cazzie Russell is a former American NBA player and coach, drafted first overall by the Knicks in 1966 and a 1970 champion.
key_facts: Cazzie Lee Russell was born on June 7, 1944.
Cazzie Russell is an American former professional basketball player and coach.
Cazzie Russell was an NBA All-Star.
The New York Knicks selected Cazzie Russell with the first overall pick of the 1966 NBA draft.
Cazzie Russell won an NBA championship with the New York Knicks in 1970.
